name: gator
description: OPA Gatekeeper policy testing CLI — run ConstraintTemplate suites and test manifests against policies locally

install_steps: Download the gator archive for your platform from https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper/releases (asset: gator-<ver>-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz) and extract to PATH
